acceptance: repo-admin-settings.md names the workflows that need the setting and no longer says nothing depends on it.
The doc states the condition for turning the setting off (approvals required, PR creation moved to an App token).
context: Replaces github-token-approval-capability-followup, dropped in the 2026-10-09 tracker review.
description:
docs/operations/repo-admin-settings.md:22-24 says `can_approve_pull_request_reviews: true` is "a leftover from the retired post-merge auto-revert job; no current workflow depends on it". That is wrong: the field is the "Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests" switch, and sync-results-data-to-published.yml:328 and seed-corpus.yml:255 run `gh pr create` with GITHUB_TOKEN (cross-surface-baseline-autodetect.yml:103,126 falls back to github.token). Following the doc and turning the setting off would break results-mirror and seed-corpus PR creation.

Correct the doc to name the dependent workflows, and add the rule: before any ruleset requires approvals, move PR creation to an App token and turn the setting off.
